newsitem.title: UK: Tomkins says trading ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Tomkins says trading ahead of budget.

text.p: Tomkins Plc said it trading performance continues ahead of budget and last year's level.

"Tomkins' companies are benefiting from a generally favourable trading environment with orderbooks, in aggregate, ahead of the same period last year," chairman Gregory Hutchings told the annual meeting.
"Our U.S. housing and construction related businesses in particular are experiencing firm conditions...In the UK the food companies are maintaining their profit growth," he said.
"The outlook for Tomkins is excellent and we look forward to extending our 15-year unbroken record of growth in earnings and dividends backed by strong cash generation," Hutchings said.
Tomkins' shares rose 6.5 pence to 269p after the statement.
